      var speech = String(speechDoc.select('span.cc-speech').text()).trim();

    tex = String(tex || '').trim();
    var slash = String.fromCharCode(92);
    if (tex.length >= 4 && tex.charAt(0) === slash && tex.charAt(1) === '(' && tex.charAt(tex.length - 2) === slash && tex.charAt(tex.length - 1) === ')') {
      return tex.substring(2, tex.length - 2).trim();

      return tex.substring(2, tex.length - 2).trim();
    }
    if (tex.length >= 4 && tex.substring(0, 2) === '$$' && tex.substring(tex.length - 2) === '$$') {
      return tex.substring(2, tex.length - 2).trim();
    }
    if (tex.length >= 2 && tex.charAt(0) === '$' && tex.charAt(tex.length - 1) === '$') {
